title: You can't get water in or get ice out!
text:
You can't get water in or get ice out!. I thought silicone would be easier. NOT!
It's nearly impossible to put water in them and carry them to the fridge and not spill them. Then try to get ice out! Forget it! Don't waste your money! Buy a hammer and some baggies and crush large cubes.
